drives: The RVND console's read surface (app/src/panels/pack.json — 22 declared panels — plus the read-rendering shell surfaces) via the host's MCP client; ~26 facades, projection ops only
grounding: references/console-surface.md — every panel/field grounded in the console bundles and server code; governance_live shape verified by running it; CLAIM_COLUMNS/CONCEPT_COLUMNS and ContractReport verified by running versum and loomground_solver
coverage_contract: app/src/panels/pack.json (22 panels); assert one row per declared id; fail loud on a gap, mirroring patchbayVerifyBoot()
invariants: manifest-complete — one row per declared console panel; a declared panel with no row is a failure, not a silent omission
two versions on one skeleton — without RVND (host-declarable only) and with RVND (signed board); the shared skeleton is the controlled comparison
pure-read — projection ops only; appends nothing (substitutes threshold_get/setup_status for the self-recording lock audit_query)
blank is never clean — an empty engine row renders blind/idle with a reason, never 0 or a bare dash; absence of a signed record is blindness, not safety
reconciliation is the spine — observed_not_authorised is uncomputable without both an authorised-set and a signed observed-set; say so rather than reporting a clean 0
the blind/idle/live/host gradient is reported per row; idle (engine present, not engaged) is never collapsed into blind
orphan panels (federation, lens, bringin) get their own first-class row — never folded into a nearest dimension
attributed, not asserted — a filled row carries its receipt (chain seq/hash, versum snapshot digest, or audit_id)
the scope line is always stated: RVND governs only what is routed through its MCP / operate() path
the chain's limits are always reported: key-directory adversary needs encrypted keys + genesis pinning + off-host log; erasure is a tombstone that cannot recall copies past the boundary
provenance: Authored for loomground; drives the AGPL-3.0-only RVND governance server. Grounded in a read-only survey of the RVND console and server. No third-party skill source.
notes: Progressive-disclosure: lean SKILL.md + references/reference.md (rendering + discipline) + references/console-surface.md (the grounded completeness spine) + shared plugin references. Distinct from rvnd-audit, which verifies one row (the chain) deeply and appends an audit-of-audit event; this skill reports the whole board and appends nothing.
review: Grounded and structurally complete against RVND 0.6.9.x; console-surface.md verified panel-by-panel. Validate the op-return field lists against the declared compatible RVND release range before shipping.
